Zion World Christian Center provides grants to help people start and grow
businesses that last. You do not have to be a member of the church to apply.

## Install on your Android phone

**1.** Tap **zwcc-business-grant.apk** under *Assets* below and wait for the
download to finish. It is about 120 MB, so use Wi-Fi if you can.

**2.** Open the downloaded file. Android may say installing from this source is
not allowed — that warning is normal for an app installed directly. Tap
**Settings**, turn on **Allow from this source**, then press back.

**3.** Tap **Install**, then **Open**.

**4.** Create an account with your email address, and allow notifications so you
hear about your application without having to check.

## Have these ready before you apply

- A recent passport photograph
- A valid means of identification — NIN slip, driver's licence, voter's card or passport
- Your business registration document
- Details of your business and what you would use the grant for

You can photograph documents with your phone, and the application saves as you
go, so you can stop and come back to it.

Android only for now. Either file below is the same app.
